repositories.name: amitkuzi.github.io
repositories.description: GitHub Pages hub for Amit Kuzi, Software Architect & Engineering Consultant in Holon, Israel. Links the live apps, source repos and published 3D models to amitkuzi.com.

repositories.name: kuziSlicer
repositories.description: Electron desktop app for loading 3D models, slicing, previewing G-code and sending validated print jobs to supported printers on a trusted LAN. Built with TypeScript.

repositories.name: localViewer
repositories.description: Local-first viewer for Markdown, YAML, CSV, STL, 3MF, STEP, OpenSCAD and images. Files never leave your browser.

repositories.name: OneWall
repositories.description: Parametric vase-mode bin, container and Gridfinity customizer that runs in the browser. Export STL, STEP and 3MF.

repositories.name: skills
repositories.description: Amit Kuzi's reusable Agent Skills for Claude and other compatible tools: Hebrew ADHD-friendly formatting, C#/.NET standards, mission orchestration, QA and more.
